description: Routes the domain's email to the Tezgah mail server (MX mail.tezgahplus.com), merges 'mx include:amazonses.com' into the SPF record, publishes the domain's DKIM key and adds autoconfig/autodiscover for mail apps. Server names are fixed; only the DKIM selector and public key vary.
variableDescription: %dkimsecici%: DKIM selector generated by the mail server for this domain (e.g. v1-rsa-20260926). %dkimanahtar%: base64 RSA public key of that selector (the TXT value is fixed to 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; h=sha256; p=<key>').
